comment: Known 1TamilMV domains, in the order the provider tries them. Domains rotate often — when the site moves, add the new domain at the top of this list AND at the top of fallbackDomains in OneTamilMVProvider.kt, then bump version in OneTamilMVProvider/build.gradle.kts. Checked 2026-10-23: 1tamilmv.fi was serving a registrar/parking page and the other mirrors were unreachable from the check location, so treat this list as a starting point, not a guarantee.
